baseline.label: Polymarket Freeze
baseline.timing: ForecastBench question-set freeze snapshot, normally 9-10 days before forecast due date

brier_index.cross_fit_aggregation: test-support-weighted mean of fold-level BI across 10 random A/B repetitions and both directions

leakage_controls.best_single_role: test-fold hindsight benchmark only; never used to form a pool
leakage_controls.freeze_probability: fixed before forecast due date; independent of event outcome

split.unit: Polymarket event_id; every recurring round for one market stays in one fold

total_variation.formula: mean(abs(p_freeze - p_model)) on original paired Bernoulli probabilities
total_variation.label: Total variation (TV)

best_single.formula: lower adjusted Brier of Polymarket Freeze and model on identical support
best_single.label: Best Single

past_only_best_single.formula: select the constituent with lower adjusted Brier on earlier common forecast dates
past_only_best_single.label: Past-only Best Single

piecewise_odds.formula: threshold-5 piecewise transform of logit(p_freeze) + logit(p_model)
piecewise_odds.label: Piecewise Odds

model_scope.definition: eligible exact merged GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi versions

near_bi.definition: absolute train/common-support BI gap between Polymarket Freeze and model <= 2.0 points

outcomes.primary: absolute aggregation Brier Index; higher is better
outcomes.score_weighting: mean adjusted Brier on exact common Polymarket targets

pair_scope.common_support: Polymarket Freeze and each model use identical source=polymarket round-events

provenance.freeze_field_mapping: event_taxonomy.market_prob is the audited rename of question-set freeze_datetime_value

imputation_audit.policy: exclude a scored Polymarket row only when every matched original ForecastBench source forecast has imputed=true

scope: non-imputed official_source_polymarket rows with a valid freeze-time probability
